------------------------------
--Creating calendar
------------------------------

CREATE VIEW gold.calendar AS
SELECT *  FROM OPENROWSET (
    BULK 'https://adwrsdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS A
